# github-slugger (vendored)

Slug rules of [github-slugger](https://github.com/Flet/github-slugger) 2.0.0 (ISC), copied byte for byte from the
npm package `github-slugger@2.0.0` (tarball sha256 `ddde66e96b7d722ff2c3d478e7595aeccae7e75dde798d405510d862f1367d0f`).
Only `index.js`, `regex.js` and `LICENSE` are kept. `scripts/checks.d/links.mjs` uses them to compute the anchors
GitHub gives to Markdown headings. Nothing here is built into the plugins. The licence text is also at
`LICENSES/ISC.txt`.
